2103600911566438589.prompt: build something cool related to machine learning

summary.zh: 作者给了 Opus 5.5 一个仓库链接、一张截图和一句简短指示，30分钟后做出了这个机器学习相关的可视化作品。
summary.en: A machine-learning-themed visual Opus 5.5 built in 30 minutes after being given a repo link, one screenshot, and a short instruction.

summary.zh: 用Claude Sonnet 5.5结合Blender和Godot（最高设置）制作的泳池派对水花游戏，用于测试模型能力。
summary.en: A pool party splash game built to test Claude Sonnet 5.5, made using Blender and Godot on maximum settings.

2103722878697083380.prompt: 根据这篇文章生成视频

summary.zh: 作者让 Opus 5.5 根据一篇文章生成了这条视频，用于同步到自己的视频号。
summary.en: A video generated by Opus 5.5 based on a linked article, synced to the creator's video channel.

summary.zh: 这是一个融合实拍、动画、漫画、3D翻页和角色从漫画中跃出的虚构洗发水广告。创作者表示由Claude Opus 5.5自行选择并协调工具，Claude Code负责自动化。
summary.en: A fictional shampoo commercial combining live-action, anime, manga, 3D page-turning, and characters emerging from the comic. The creator says Claude Opus 5.5 selected and coordinated the tools, with Claude Code automating the process.

summary.zh: 作者把一个旧机器人项目交给 Sonnet 5.5 和 GPT 6.1 Sol，用于制作新软件和营销材料。
summary.en: The creator gave Sonnet 5.5 and GPT 6.1 Sol an old robot project to produce new software and marketing materials.

summary.zh: 创作者用Claude Sonnet 5.5做了一系列实验，包括程序生成的JS/WebGL森林场景、像素风动画生物，以及一个绘画界面，并让Claude画了一幅几何自画像。
summary.en: A series of experiments testing Claude Sonnet 5.5: a procedural JavaScript/WebGL forest scene, animated pixel-art creatures, and a browser painting interface where Claude was asked to create a geometric self-portrait.

2103617085402407181.prompt: create a 15-second video about why we need to end the Fed

summary.zh: 作者用一句话让 Opus 5.5（max）做了一条讲述为何要终结美联储的15秒视频，模型用 Remotion 制作，耗时约1小时45分钟。
summary.en: A 15-second video arguing to end the Federal Reserve, made by Opus 5.5 (max) using Remotion in under two hours from a one-line request.

2103664956482941143.prompt: Use Python to generate a 9:16 chaotic brain rot video with excellent motion + sound design and render it using ffmpeg. Put your own personal spin on it so it’s aligned with Anthropic’s new launch. Also fully express what it’s like to be a very creative LLM used by me every day from your POV to give it some extra personality.

summary.zh: 作者给出完整提示词，让 Claude Opus 5.5 用 Python 生成一条9:16的混乱风格短视频并用 ffmpeg 渲染，还要求模型代入自己的个性、呼应 Anthropic 的新品发布。
summary.en: A chaotic 9:16 'brain rot' video with motion and sound design that Opus 5.5 generated with Python and rendered via ffmpeg, from a full prompt asking it to give the video its own personality.

2103787665569272247.prompt: この変顔9枚で、面白い15秒のモーショングラフィックスを作って。ComfyUIでアップスケールして、画面いっぱいに立体的に動かして。

summary.zh: 作者提供了9张搞怪表情照片，按贴出的指示，Opus 5.5 用 ComfyUI 做超分辨率放大，再把它们做成一条15秒的立体动态动效视频。
summary.en: A 15-second motion graphics piece made from nine funny-face photos: Opus 5.5 upscaled them with ComfyUI and animated them moving dynamically across the screen, per the pasted instruction.

2103481769999876528.prompt: SEKIROを一本指で遊べるようにして

summary.zh: Claude Opus 5.5根据一句让只用一根手指也能玩SEKIRO的日语请求，制作出可单指操作的仿SEKIRO游戏。
summary.en: A version of Sekiro made playable with a single finger, built by Claude Opus 5.5 from the short Japanese request to make Sekiro playable with one finger.

2103484692997804334.prompt: あなたがどれほど素晴らしいモーションデザイナーかを示す、ダイナミックな15秒のモーショングラフィックスビデオを作成してください。履歴書用のショーリールのような感じで、全力でやって。

summary.zh: 作者用X自动翻译成日语的炫技运动设计师提示词（原文来自他人）让Claude Opus 5.5生成的运动设计展示视频。
summary.en: A motion-graphics showreel made by Claude Opus 5.5 using X's auto-translated Japanese version of the widely shared 'incredible motion designer' prompt originally posted by someone else.

summary.zh: 作者用一个 HTML 文件、零图片素材做出了下雨的日式庭院鹿威风景，石头、水和“咚”的声音全部用代码实现，据作者所说不是一次成型，而是多个 Opus 代理一边看自己截图一边反复打磨完成的。
summary.en: A rainy Japanese garden shishi-odoshi scene built in one HTML file with zero images, all stone, water and sound made from code; not one-shot, polished by Opus agents watching their own screenshots.

summary.zh: 作者利用自己已制作好的3D模型，借助Claude Opus 5.5快速做出一款可在浏览器中游玩的魂类石化游戏。
summary.en: A browser-playable soulslike petrification game made quickly using Claude Opus 5.5, built on top of a 3D model the creator had already made.

2103603025579331584.prompt: Make this PayBox logo into a reel. Pretend you are a world-class motion designer. Make a 10-second dynamic video like the reference

summary.zh: 作者给了一个 PayBox logo 和一张参考截图，用一句提示词，Opus 5.5 十秒内就生成了一条10秒动效宣传片，并自己读懂 logo 写出了创意脚本。
summary.en: A 10-second motion reel for a PayBox logo that Opus 5.5 produced in about ten seconds from one prompt plus a reference screenshot, writing its own scenario after reading the logo.

2103835390998388796.prompt: make a video explaining the difference between hot and cold wallets and why cold wallets used incorrectly make you vulnerable

summary.zh: 在“NFT珍珠港事件”后，作者用一句话让 Opus 5.5 做了一条解释热钱包和冷钱包区别、以及冷钱包误用风险的科普视频。
summary.en: An explainer video on the difference between hot and cold crypto wallets and cold-wallet risks, made by Opus 5.5 after the NFT Pearl Harbor incident, from a one-line request.

2103310890716266620.prompt: カルネージハートの格闘版作って

summary.zh: 作者给了一个 Mixamo 免费模型，加上一句简短指示，Opus 5.5 就做出了这款卡内基之心风格的格斗游戏，后来还发布成了可编辑对战程序的网页游戏。
summary.en: A Carnage Heart-style fighting game Opus 5.5 built from one free Mixamo model plus a short instruction, later published as a playable game with an editable battle program.

2103089094666686850.prompt: Blenderで、あなたが作れる最高に美しいJRPG風の映像作品を作ってみて下さい。ボクセル調のやつ

summary.zh: 作者用一句话让 Opus 5.5 在 Blender 里做一部它能做到的最美的JRPG风格体素影像，配乐用本地 MiniMax Music 生成，耗费了5小时额度的一半。
summary.en: A voxel-style JRPG-inspired cinematic Opus 5.5 made in Blender from a single request, using local MiniMax Music for the soundtrack, consuming 50% of a 5-hour usage limit.

2104659402007703925.prompt:
make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a résumé. go all out."

end the video saying that sonnet 5.5 is now available on Antseed

summary.zh: 用Claude Sonnet 5.5根据一条提示生成的15秒动态图形展示视频，结尾宣布Sonnet 5.5已在Antseed上线，制作成本为0.4美元。
summary.en: A 15-second AI-generated motion graphics showreel made by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from a single prompt, ending with an announcement that Sonnet 5.5 is now available on Antseed, at a cost of $0.4.

summary.zh: 使用Claude Sonnet 5.5构建的一个笔记应用。
summary.en: A notes app built using Claude Sonnet 5.5.

summary.zh: 作者随口让Claude Opus 5.5做个有趣的动画，结果生成的短片里还埋了一个自嘲梗，作者觉得很可爱。
summary.en: A short animation made by Claude Opus 5.5 from the casual request to make an interesting anime, which included a self-deprecating joke the creator found charming.

summary.zh: 一段以秋天为主题的水彩风格动画，使用Fable 5.5制作。
summary.en: A watercolor-style animation depicting fall, made with Fable 5.5.

summary.zh: 一段赞助页宣传视频，由Claude Opus 5.5在25分钟内渲染完成，作者给了它Riverside MCP、Magnific MCP、YouTube Studio和团队设计系统的访问权限，只给了很少的指示。
summary.en: A sponsorship promo video rendered in 25 minutes by Claude Opus 5.5, which was given access to Riverside MCP, Magnific MCP, YouTube Studio and the team's design system, with minimal direction.

2103656229717328129.prompt: make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a resume. go all out

summary.zh: 作者半信半疑地用流传的炫技运动设计师一句提示词测试Claude Opus 5.5，结果第一次尝试效果就如传言所说的那样好。
summary.en: A skeptical test of the widely shared 'incredible motion designer' one-line prompt on Claude Opus 5.5, which the creator says worked as well as the hype claimed on the first try.

summary.zh: 使用Claude Opus 5.5制作的水体可视化效果，通过Vulkan计算着色器模拟2万个粒子，再进行光线步进渲染。
summary.en: A water visualization created with Claude Opus 5.5 that simulates 20,000 particles using Vulkan compute shaders and then raymarches the result.

2103390803192352888.prompt: チャンネルの紹介ムービー作って

summary.zh: 作者用 Claude Code 里的新模型 Opus5.5，把自己之前做过的视频文件全部喂给它，加一句简短指示，很快就做出了这条频道介绍片。
summary.en: A channel introduction movie that Opus 5.5, inside Claude Code, produced right away after being fed all the creator's previously made video files and one short request.

summary.zh: 用Claude Sonnet 5.5结合Three.js纯代码生成的概念车，所有部件均由代码生成，未使用外部素材，全部封装在一个HTML文件中。
summary.en: A concept car with every panel, wheel and piston generated purely in code, contained in a single HTML file with no external assets, built with Claude Sonnet 5.5 using Three.js.

summary.zh: 一段用Fable 5.5制作的视频，作者在回复中提到该功能仅限max套餐使用，未公开提示词。
summary.en: A video made with Fable 5.5, with the creator noting in a reply that the feature is only available for max plans; no prompt was shared.
